Coverage: NJ statewide sales volume series 2021 FY ($3.04B N/C NJ via CBRE/ROI-NJ), 2022 (YTD Oct $2.87B re-nj; YTD Nov $2.95B CommercialEdge), 2023 (YTD Oct $2.24B; FY $2.6B / 12.9 MSF), 2024 (Q1 $127.4M Transwestern; Q1 $520M CommercialEdge; YTD Feb $171M; YTD May $753M; YTD Jun ~$1.1B; Q3 $879M, Q4 $881.8M Transwestern; YTD Nov $2.5B), 2025 (YTD Feb $351M; Q1 $409M CoStar vs $832M CommercialEdge - different data vendors, both kept with attribution); $/SF series 2022-2025 ($175 to $339); cap rates: 2019 4.0% (GlobeSt) and Class A ~4% (Bisnow), 2022 Class A 3.00-3.25% norm / sub-3% trades (re-nj), 2024 mid-5% (NJBIZ), YE2025 NNJ 6.31% warehouse / 6.80% flex with 7.53%/8.01% discount rates (IRR Viewpoint 2026); fundamentals (vacancy, availability, rents, absorption, under construction, inventory) 2019-2025 from Transwestern, CommercialEdge, TRD, GlobeSt, ROI-NJ, Rutgers/NAIOP; IOS: Central NJ $8-10K/acre lease range (Fennelly) and two DERIVED $/acre sale figures (~$3.21M/acre Harrison-Kearny 2024, ~$3.76M/acre South Plainfield 2025, computed from stated price and acreage); cold storage: CBRE cold-vs-dry cap-rate spread 75 bps (from 200), NJ cold inventory 6 MSF (0.8% of ~700 MSF), 2025 gateway-market cold cap rates 5.0-5.5% (low-reliability consultant blog). Caveats are in each row's notes: rows marked 'ATTRIBUTION FLAG' have the figure stated in search output but the exact article among a firm's several NJ pieces was inferred (CPE 2023 FY/2024 YTD series, CBRE 2021/Q1 2022 volume via ROI-NJ, re-nj cap-rate quotes, Colliers Q4 2021 count via REBusinessOnline); rows marked 'DATE UNVERIFIED' have an approximate year because publication dates were not shown (Bisnow Class A cap rates, Fennelly IOS rents, re-nj cold storage pieces, CoStar owner-user and construction-start articles); Transwestern 6.7%/7.2% vacancy attributed to the Q4 2024 report but the summary blended Q1 and Q4 2024 reports. Some rows overlap sibling workstreams by source firm (Avison Young, Colliers, CBRE-via-press) because D3/D4/D5 files were empty at run time; dedupe downstream by source_url+metric. Non-NJ national figures (US $115B 2023 industrial sales, national $126-129/SF) were intentionally omitted. One 2018 prior-year cap-rate point was folded into the 2019 Bisnow row notes rather than written as a 2018 row.
